# quicknode_kv_value (Resource)

A value in the Quicknode Key-Value Store. Streams filters can read and update it, for example a threshold or the last block processed.

A filter that writes the value shows up as a change, and the next apply sets it back. Values and lists are separate, so a value and a list can share a key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A setting a Streams filter reads with qnLib.qnGetValue("alert-threshold").
resource "quicknode_kv_value" "alert_threshold" {
  key   = "alert-threshold"
  value = "1000000"
}

# Values are strings; use jsonencode for structured settings.
resource "quicknode_kv_value" "alert_config" {
  key = "alert-config"
  value = jsonencode({
    min_value_usd = 50000
    tokens        = ["USDC", "USDT"]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Name of the value, as filters refer to it. Up to 255 letters, digits, spaces and `.` `:` `_` `-` `$`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `value` (String) The value, as a string. Use `jsonencode` for structured data. Terraform state holds it in plain text.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `key`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Values are imported by their key.
terraform import quicknode_kv_value.alert_threshold alert-threshold
```
